verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents a management API for programmatically creating and rotating API keys. A hands-on user confirms you can mint keys with per-key expiry and spend limits, and workspace budgets add hard dollar caps, so you can issue bounded credentials per agent. However, nothing shows permission-level scoping, such as restricting a key to certain models, endpoints or read-only actions, so 'least-privilege' is met only through spend and expiry limits. Missing for 10: per-key permission/model/endpoint scopes, in-depth docs on key limit settings, agent-specific credential guidance.
